units.source_text: 无论是千代子的姐姐还是姐夫，他都是初次见面。

en.t: Whether it was Chiyoko's sister or her brother-in-law, he was meeting them for the first time.

units.source_text: 姐姐和姐夫倘若不同意妹妹这桩婚事，大可以说不知道这回事。

en.t: If her sister and brother-in-law did not approve of this marriage for the younger sister, they could simply say they knew nothing about it.
